body:
Related to #4. **No new board, collision, policy or score has been collected.** [PR #114](https://github.com/jimmy-sim/poker-ai/pull/114) improved the two known games at matched 40m work but failed the wet absolute 0.01-pot gate. [PR #115](https://github.com/jimmy-sim/poker-ai/pull/115) showed the full expected trainer is deterministic, so changing nominal seeds cannot estimate variability. Earlier PR #107's newly drawn two-combo inputs had zero turn collisions; PR #109's fixed three-stratum screen stopped at a low/wet failure after structurally inspecting its medium candidates. Those failures and all prior inputs remain excluded and unchanged.

The [prospective protocol](docs/known-turn-collision-medium-transfer.md) and [machine contract](configs/known-turn-collision-medium-transfer.json) fix four new medium OOP board/range inputs (two dry, two wet), 49 pinned prior input exclusions, one score-free first-eligible PCG64(20261625) collision screen with at least four collided turn rows and fixed candidate/time caps, unchanged q8 control/exact-turn candidate, deterministic full expected 10m/20m/40m matched work, per-spot absolute and paired strength gates, fixed 5m three-repeat profile, strict separate `2*(2*T+600)<7200` admission, own-before-reference order, 900-second selection/profile/audit caps, 7200-second own cap and 1.5GB worker RSS cap. Conditional conclusions apply only to selected collision-containing medium OOP restricted games. No default promotion.

**Publication and qualification, November 24 PST.** Protocol commit `682b5431` and all five changed blobs were verified byte for byte on GitHub before source or selection. [Protocol CI45554232043](https://github.com/jimmy-sim/poker-ai/actions/runs/45554232043) passed both Python 3.11 and 3.12 jobs/hooks; official full logs and metadata are saved. Isolated adapter/test source at `a96e37fd` is pushed, all 14 changed blobs GitHub-byte-verified. Focused Ruff, formatting, strict mypy and 31 tests passed; exact-head all-file hooks passed. All four guarded exact-source local lanes passed: base Python 3.11/3.12 each 5,854 tests/73 skips/150 slow deselections, optional 3.11 2,601 passed, optional 3.12 2,599 passed/2 skipped, with pre/post source/lock/runtime/reference-license guards. [Exact-source CI45558165765](https://github.com/jimmy-sim/poker-ai/actions/runs/45558165765) first attempt: Python 3.12 passed; Python 3.11 was **canceled at the unchanged 35-minute limit at 97% of tests**, before hooks, with no assertion failure visible. Official full first-attempt metadata/log are retained separately. A targeted Python 3.11 same-SHA operational requalification (attempt 2) passed all 5,854 tests and hooks, with no timeout, source, test or scientific protocol change. One earlier local source qualification was intentionally interrupted to add the missing direct first-eligible selection test; its partial log and failed receipt are retained separately, with no scientific work affected. The [exact-source receipt](results/known-turn-collision-medium-transfer/source-checks/manifest.json) is published and all 30 changed receipt/docs blobs were GitHub-byte-verified. The single [score-free screen](results/known-turn-collision-medium-transfer/screen/manifest.json) retained all 34 physical inputs, selecting first eligible dry A/wet A/dry B/wet B attempts 3/15/1/15 with 18/12/12/24 collided exact turn rows and zero river collisions, in 334.579 launcher seconds (<900). All 46 screen checkpoint blobs were verified. The [four-input freeze](configs/known-turn-collision-medium-transfer-freeze.json) copies those selected raw bytes exactly; all eight changed freeze/docs blobs were verified. The [fictional proof](results/known-turn-collision-medium-transfer/own-proof/manifest.json) passed once in 1.372 seconds, with two matching six-readout synthetic arms; all 35 changed proof/docs blobs were verified. **No admitted 40m comparison or independent audit has begun.** The fixed 24-path 5m profile is active under its 900-second cap, with logs/PIDs in the durable handoff.

This draft PR remains open through source qualification, one-time screen/freeze, proof, profile, admission, one admitted study if permitted, independent comparison-only audit, fixed report and final checks. Preserve all failed gates; no scientific retry, cap increase, historical source-pin change or reference strategy in training.
title: Test exact-turn transfer on new collision-containing medium inputs
